android.desc: Looking for a simple and efficient way to manage your tasks, notes and to-do's? Look no further than microtasks - the must-have app for staying organized and on top of your daily schedule. With a plain and user-friendly interface, microtasks makes it easy to add, edit, and schedule your tasks directly from the notification area. Whether you need to remember small things throughout the day or build new habits, microtasks has you covered. Plus, with its awesome night mode feature, microtasks is perfect for dark theme lovers. And, with recurring task options, you can ensure that you never forget important deadlines or appointments. Choose from a range of colors to help you prioritize and highlight important tasks, and take advantage of our locked feature to avoid accidentally swiping tasks away. But that's not all! Microtasks also offers silent notifications to minimize disruptions, making it perfect for sudden inspiration notes or anything else you need to remember. With a quick settings tile for fast access, and tasks restored automatically when the device is restarted, microtasks is the ultimate task management app for busy people on the go. But don't just take our word for it! Join the thousands of satisfied users who have downloaded microtasks today. And don't forget to leave us feedback on our feature request platform at https://microtasks.nolt.io/. Download microtasks now and start taking control of your to-do's with ease! Features at a glance ⬜ Plain simple interface. View past, present and current tasks. 😎 Awesome night mode for dark theme lovers. 🚀 Quickly add & edit tasks / todos / notes from notifications themselves. 🕗 Schedule one-off or recurring tasks. Perfect for habit building. 🌈 Choose different colors for your tasks. 👀 Always visible in the notification area. Highlight important tasks. 🏎️ Quick Settings tile available for fast access. 🔒 "Locked" by default for no accidental swipe. 👊 Tasks are restored when the device is restarted.
